# Ardeno Studio

> Ardeno Studio is a Colombo, Sri Lanka web design and development studio building custom websites, booking systems, redesigns, and AI-assisted lead flows for Sri Lankan businesses and global clients.

## What Ardeno Studio does

Ardeno Studio builds premium custom-coded websites and browser-based digital systems. The studio focuses on first impression, mobile clarity, performance, conversion paths, security-ready launches, and post-launch support.

## Core services

- Premium Business Website: custom-coded responsive business websites with metadata, performance, and conversion basics included.
- Website Redesign Sprint: focused rebuilds for businesses whose current website feels outdated, unclear, slow, or weaker than the business.
- Booking and Order System: browser-based booking, ordering, and portal systems for restaurants, salons, service teams, clinics, events, and appointment-led businesses.
- AI Lead Assistant: secure website assistants that answer visitor questions, qualify leads, and guide users after hours.

## Dedicated service answers

### How can I build a custom booking system for my business?

Start by mapping the booking journey: what the customer selects, what information the business needs, how staff confirm availability, and what happens after submission. Ardeno can build the customer form, service selection, date and time handling, notifications, admin records, confirmations, reminders, payments, or calendar sync when useful.

### What features should a professional booking system include?

A professional booking system should include a mobile-friendly booking form, service or package selection, date and time handling, customer contact capture, validation, staff notifications, readable admin records, confirmation messages, and privacy-aware handling of customer details. Advanced versions can add deposits, reminders, dashboards, portals, and calendar sync.

### How do I start building a professional business website?

Start with the business goal, target customer, services, proof, brand assets, required pages, and the action visitors should take. Ardeno turns that into page structure, copy direction, design, development, metadata, testing, and handover.

### How can I increase sales through my company website?

A company website increases sales when visitors quickly understand the offer, trust the business, see proof, and have an easy next step. Ardeno improves this through clearer service pages, stronger first impressions, fast mobile layouts, better calls to action, lead capture, booking or order flows, and analytics-ready launch checks.

### When should I redesign my website?

Redesign when the site does not reflect the quality of the business, visitors cannot understand the offer quickly, mobile layouts feel awkward, pages load slowly, or calls to action are hidden. Ardeno audits the current site, preserves useful assets, and rebuilds the priority pages around trust, clarity, performance, and conversion.

### What can an AI lead assistant do on a website?

An AI lead assistant can answer common questions, explain services, guide visitors to the right page, ask qualifying questions, and hand off to a form, email, WhatsApp, or booking flow. Ardeno builds this behind protected server-side endpoints with approved business context, validation, rate limits, and abuse controls.

### How do I choose between custom development and website builders?

Use a website builder for simple brochure sites, fast experiments, and tight budgets. Choose custom development when the business needs stronger brand differentiation, booking or ordering flows, dashboards, custom integrations, AI assistants, ownership of the code, performance control, or long-term flexibility.

## Frequently answered questions

### How much does a website from Ardeno cost?

Every project is scoped individually because every business is different. Pricing depends on complexity, custom features, content needs, integrations, and project goals. Ardeno Studio provides a clear custom quote after a discovery call.

### How long does it take to build a website?

A standard business website usually takes 2 to 4 weeks from kickoff to launch. More complex portals, ecommerce builds, booking systems, or custom web applications typically run 4 to 8 weeks.

### Who owns the website after it is built?

The client owns the website after final payment is made. Full ownership of the code and design passes to the client with no lock-in or licensing fees.

### Can Ardeno redesign an existing website?

Yes. Ardeno Studio audits what is working, identifies weak first impressions or conversion issues, and rebuilds the site from a stronger design, technical, and content foundation.

### How can I build a custom booking system for my business?

Start by mapping the booking journey: what the customer selects, what information the business needs, how staff confirm availability, and what happens after the booking request is sent. Ardeno Studio can build custom booking systems for restaurants, salons, clinics, events, service teams, and other appointment-led businesses.

### What features should a professional booking system include?

A professional booking system should include a clear booking form, service or package selection, date and time handling, customer contact capture, staff notifications, admin-friendly records, confirmation messages, and privacy-aware data handling. More advanced builds can add payments, calendar sync, dashboards, reminders, and customer portals.

### Can I automate customer appointments on my website?

Yes. A website can automate customer appointment requests, confirmations, notifications, reminders, and admin records. Ardeno usually recommends starting with a controlled request-and-confirmation flow before adding complex real-time scheduling, payments, or calendar integrations.

### How do I choose between custom development and website builders?

Website builders are useful for simple brochure sites with limited custom logic. Custom development is the better fit when the business needs stronger brand differentiation, faster interaction, booking or ordering flows, dashboards, custom integrations, ownership of the code, or a site that is not locked into a generic template.

### What digital marketing strategies work best for local businesses?

Local businesses usually need a clear website, accurate Google and social profiles, service pages that match buyer questions, local SEO basics, strong proof or reviews, fast mobile pages, and conversion paths such as calls, forms, WhatsApp, bookings, or lead magnets. Ardeno focuses on making the website credible and conversion-ready first.

### How can I increase sales through my company website?

A company website increases sales when visitors quickly understand the offer, trust the business, see proof, and have an easy next step. Ardeno improves this through clearer service pages, stronger first impressions, faster mobile layouts, better calls to action, lead capture, booking or order flows, and analytics-ready launch checks.

### How do I start building a professional business website?

Start with the business goal, target customer, services, proof, brand assets, required pages, and the action visitors should take. Ardeno turns that into a scoped website plan, then designs, builds, tests, launches, and hands over a custom site or web system.
